job.title: [Post] ... looking for experienced SFCC (Salesforce Commerce ... Hiring #SFCC #SalesforceCommerce…

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | Java, Spring, REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, headless commerce, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning, and techno-functional analysis bridging business and IT. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong stakeholder management and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Experienced SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Navya Velpula’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge Salesforce Commerce solutions. With over five years of senior e-commerce development on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless APIs, data integration and high-performance platforms that align perfectly with your SFCC initiatives.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs, enabling seamless storefront and third-party integrations across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Data Integration
bullets.text: Built robust PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring accurate product catalog synchronization with ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Platform Expertise
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions (Hybris 2105/2211), covering product, pricing, OMS and promotions, supporting high-traffic B2B/B2C sites.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, author user stories and functional specs, and translate them into scalable commerce solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site arrangements.

tailoring.why_company: Navya Velpula’s focus on Salesforce Commerce Cloud represents the forefront of modern e-commerce, a space where my extensive experience in headless APIs, large-scale integrations and agile delivery can add immediate value. I am eager to apply my proven SAP Commerce expertise to help accelerate your SFCC projects and drive innovative customer experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my 5+ years of senior e-commerce development and integration expertise to help Navya Velpula build world-class Salesforce Commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce developer with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud. I’m keen to bring my API and integration expertise to Navya Velpula’s SFCC team. Open to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Experienced SFCC Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Experienced SFCC Developer role. With over five years of senior e-commerce development on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your Salesforce Commerce initiatives.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
